# Unchecked payload access

Several body renderers index into entity.payload with required keys (e.g. p['method'], p['route'], p['kind'], p['language']) without exception handling. If payloads are missing expected keys, the emitter will raise KeyError and the emit run can fail.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/wiki/emitter.py` — `knowledge_compiler.wiki.emitter.WikiEmitter._body_api`
- `knowledge_compiler/wiki/emitter.py` — `knowledge_compiler.wiki.emitter.WikiEmitter._body_component`
